category_feedback.specific_evidence: expanded_walkthrough.recovery_moves = ['Cover one hand.', 'Drill short = hour.', 'Compare analog to digital.'] — concrete but extremely terse, no research citation, and recovery does not branch on what the diagnostic told you about the child.
category_feedback.required_fix: Cite the research basis for the hour/minute confusion (e.g., Friedman & Laycock 1989 on children's clock reading, or Earnest 2017 on temporal reasoning) and branch recovery_moves: if child can read DIGITAL but not analog, drill hand-length contrast with covered-hand isolation; if child cannot count by 5s around the face, drop back to skip-counting on a number line before reintroducing the minute hand; if child reverses hands consistently, use a colour-coded hour/minute overlay. Each branch should be a substitute-followable sentence.

category_feedback.specific_evidence: lesson_specific_materials lists 'All previous manipulatives at 4 stations' plus Big Farm Templates and Clock Cards (16); differentiation includes 'Walk between 4 stations physically' but there is no explicit NO-PAPER, NO-PURCHASE alternative path. The capstone effectively requires the full materials kit from days 1-4 to run.
category_feedback.required_fix: Add a no-materials version to differentiation: e.g., 'No-paper version — replace stations with body math: perimeter = pace around a chalk-outlined rectangle on the floor and count steps; area = lay hands palm-down to tile a desk and count handprints; capacity = clap once per cup as you fill an imagined pail (6 claps) vs bowl (3 claps); time = teacher calls out a time and children form the hands with their arms (short arm = hour, long arm = minute).' This makes Day 5 runnable when the materials kit is missing.

category_feedback.specific_evidence: consolidation.exit_routine = "Each child shares ONE: 'My favourite measurement was ___.'" — this is a fill-in stem, not a memorable chant, and the unit lacks a distinctive quotable refrain children carry between lessons. Roo and Cal speak in the teacher_script but no signature line repeats.
category_feedback.required_fix: Add a signature refrain that Roo and Cal close every lesson with — e.g., 'Roo says MEASURE AROUND, Cal says MEASURE THE CLOCK — pick the RIGHT TOOL!' Children chant it back at the consolidation. Reference back to it in the exit_routine so it carries between lessons. Place the chant in teacher_script and quote it verbatim in the consolidation.

category_feedback.specific_evidence: expanded_walkthrough names the trap as hour/minute hand confusion but does NOT cite research-grounded terms (Carpenter & Moser CGI types, Friedman on time concepts, Battista on spatial reasoning, etc.), and the action steps are procedural application of taught methods — children do not invent or compare strategies for, e.g., how to find the perimeter of the L-shape or how to compare capacity when units differ.
category_feedback.required_fix: In action.steps, add a strategy-comparison move: 'Pause the room at min 15. Ask two children at the perimeter station to share HOW they found the perimeter of the L-shape — did they add all 6 sides one at a time, or did they use the rectangle trick (length + width) × 2 and adjust? Compare which is faster and why both give the same number.' In expanded_walkthrough.rationale, name the misconception in research-grounded terms (e.g., 'Friedman 1989 on hand-length salience; children attend to the more visually prominent long hand and over-weight it as the hour indicator').

category_feedback.specific_evidence: Lesson success_criteria has 4 items including 'I can PICK the right tool for the job.' but the worksheet's 3 parts only practise reading clocks, measuring perimeter/area, and comparing capacity/mass — there is no worksheet item that practises the 'pick the right tool' criterion, and the worksheet is essentially a rote repeat of station tasks rather than a transfer task.
category_feedback.required_fix: Add a Part 4 'Pick the Tool' to the worksheet that lists 4 measurement jobs (e.g., 'distance from school to the park', 'space inside a barn floor', 'how much milk a pail holds', 'how long it takes to feed the cows') and asks children to circle the right tool/unit (km, m², cups, minutes) for each. This (a) practises the 4th success criterion the lesson teaches but the worksheet currently skips, and (b) varies the practice format from the station rotation into a transfer task — covering the Level-4 'deliberately varies and justifies' bar.
